standard_form: For natural multi-indices d,k, the product over their finitely many relevant coordinates of choose(k_j,d_j) vanishes exactly when some d_j exceeds k_j. Equivalently it is nonzero/positive iff d is at most k coordinatewise.
generality: Finite tuples extend to arbitrary variable types using finite lower support. Current theorem has two Finsupp indices because hasseCoeff fixes that signature, but the expanded product only needs lower d finitely supported: upper k can be arbitrary σ→ℕ, with pointwise bound on RHS.
